title: Chapter 188 Leaving
content:
Chapter 188 Leaving

At the original place, Lu Xue watched the two people leave on their own, and her mouth twitched slightly.

I picked it up, right?

At this time, Lu Daosheng suddenly remembered something, looked back, and immediately saw Lu Xue's resentful look.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng smiled dumbly, "Xiaoxue, do you want to enter the fairyland by yourself, or choose to follow us?"

Hearing this question, Lu Xue was slightly stunned.

She knew that this was her father testing her.

Beside Lu Daosheng, Yan Lingyun also looked at Lu Xue with hope.

She was looking forward to her daughter's answer.

Looking at her parents, Lu Xue was silent for a long time, and then smiled and said: "Of course I will go with you."

It's so funny, why not take the shortcut.

Do you really think she is stupid.

Ao Qing directly raised his thumb, "My lady, you really didn't let me down."

Hearing Lu Xue's answer, Lu Daosheng was slightly stunned, but then shook his head and smiled.

"You girl."

Lu Daosheng was not angry, because Lu Xue was his daughter. No matter what choice Lu Xue made, he would unconditionally choose to support her.

Instead of forcing his children to do things they don't like like some parents.

In that case, it would only backfire.

In Lu Daosheng's heart, as long as Lu Xue lived happily, that was enough.

On the side, Yan Lingyun also laughed.

Lu Xue's answer really surprised her. She thought Lu Xue would prove herself in order to please the two of them, and then choose to go to the fairyland on her own.

But Lu Xue didn't.

She is worthy of being his daughter, with personality.

"Xiaoxue, the fairyland is different from here. In case you can't stand it, you should adapt to the world created by your father first."

Then, without waiting for Lu Xue to answer, Lu Daosheng stretched out his hand and directly took Lu Xue into the world in his palm.

"Oh, I almost forgot."

Lu Daosheng looked towards the inner city of the deserted city.

I saw that everyone in the inner city had made sufficient preparations and waited for a long time.

As early as half a month ago, Lu Daosheng already knew the list of people who wanted to go to the fairyland together.

Of course, those who can be on the list must have a high status in the deserted city, and at least they must be able to live in the inner city.

For this, Lu Daosheng did not refuse.

"Master, the city lord will not forget us, right?"

Seeing that there was no movement here, an old man Zhang stepped forward cautiously and asked.

Hearing this, the master of the Zhang family slapped him directly.

"Asshole! How dare you question the city lord?!"

The face of the master of the Zhang family was angry.

Seeing this, the elder hurriedly begged for mercy, "Master, I know I was wrong, I know I was wrong."

However, the master of the Zhang family shook his face coldly, "Come on, take him away and cancel the place in the fairyland."

"Yes, master."

Immediately, two guards of the Zhang family stepped forward and took the elder away.

"Master, please don't! I shouldn't have questioned the Lord of the City. I know I was wrong!"

The last voice was stretched out, but it still failed to get the forgiveness of the Master of the Zhang Family.

Lord of the City, no doubt.

At this point, no one dared to say a word, and waited for the Lord of the City to call.

Lu Daosheng saw all of this scene, without saying much, and waved his hand. Suddenly, all the people on the list in the deserted city began to emit light, and the next moment, everyone disappeared from the spot.

......

"Look, that's the Lord of the City!"

"And the Lord of the City's wife."

"Is the Lord of the City leaving?"

In the deserted city, everyone looked up and saw the two figures in the void, and they were immediately filled with emotion.

At this moment, they knew that the backbone of the deserted city was leaving.

Leaving this world.

Thinking of Lu Daosheng's departure, everyone couldn't help but feel sad, but they would not keep Lu Daosheng.

"The Lord of the City has been protecting us for a long time."

In the deserted city, an old man looked at the void, his eyes slightly red.

"This deserted city is not only the Lord of the City, but also ours."

"Yes, the Lord of the City has left, and what we have to do is to help the Lord of the City protect this place. I believe that one day, the Lord of the City will definitely come back!"

Hearing this, everyone's emotions also rose.

"We, wait, send the Lord of the City off!"

The collective shouts sounded from the deserted city, the voice was loud and the momentum was high, and it immediately resounded throughout the star field.

In the void.

Hearing the movement below, Lu Daosheng stopped and looked back, with a gratified smile on his face.

"Before leaving, I will give everyone one last gift."

Lu Daosheng muttered to himself, and then waved his hand.

In an instant, the stars in the sky fell, like meteors constantly pouring down from the sky.

In the deserted city, everyone looked at the stunning scene in front of them, their eyes full of shock.

At this time, dots of starlight fell in the deserted city, and suddenly some people began to exclaim.

"Grace! Grace! Grace from the Lord of the City!"

The dots of starlight gradually merged into the body of the cultivator, and suddenly turned into a magnificent energy, which was also mixed with the power of the law.

After the cultivator absorbed it, he immediately began to realize it on the spot.

Several cultivators even broke through on the spot.

"Thank you, Lord of the City!"

In the void, Lu Daosheng nodded, and finally took another look at the deserted city below.

Everything has been prepared and is foolproof.

Although the departure of Huang Shou, An Xing and others has reduced the strength of Huangcheng in Xuanling Star Domain, it still does not hinder Huangcheng's dominance in all star domains.

Moreover, who says that Huang Shou and his men are the only top fighters in Huangcheng?

No one knows how many strong men Lu Daosheng has secretly cultivated in the deepest part of Huangcheng City Lord's Mansion.

Once Huangcheng is in trouble, even if Lu Daosheng is not there, no strong man can do anything to Huangcheng.

This is the absolute strength of Huangcheng.

Then, Lu Daosheng did not stop, and turned to pull Yan Lingyun towards the immortal gate.

In a blink of an eye, the magnificent immortal gate was already in sight.

"I'll do it myself."

Yan Lingyun spoke softly, and then slowly moved forward alone.

Buzz——

Just as Yan Lingyun approached, the immortal gate suddenly moved.

Seeing this, Yan Lingyun seemed to have expected it, and her expression disappeared, and she punched out directly.

This punch contained her own way.

There was a loud bang.

There was no movement at the immortal gate.

And inside the gate, it was hazy.

"Go."

Behind him, Lu Daosheng smiled.

Yan Lingyun nodded slightly, and then stepped in.

Suddenly, a flash of light flashed in front of her.

Countless complex immortal laws rushed towards Yan Lingyun, and Yan Lingyun closed her eyes slightly, enjoying the baptism of the law.

I don't know how long it took, and the surrounding light suddenly began to shuttle rapidly around Yan Lingyun.

Click!

The space was broken, and Yan Lingyun opened her eyes again.

The scene in front of her changed suddenly, and a faint fairy air floated in the void, a more stable space, and complex rules and avenues continued to interweave.

It was like the immortal world.

"I'm back again."
